dslRule:
<!id: jdt-editor-add-bracket-highlight-prefs>
<!description: Adds new preference keys for bracket highlighting to SourceViewerDecorationSupport.setMatchingCharacterPainterPreferenceKeys.>
<!severity: INFO>

$support.setMatchingCharacterPainterPreferenceKeys($key1, $key2) :: instanceof($support, "org.eclipse.jface.text.source.SourceViewerDecorationSupport")
=>
$support.setMatchingCharacterPainterPreferenceKeys($key1, $key2, org.eclipse.jdt.ui.PreferenceConstants.EDITOR_HIGHLIGHT_BRACKET_AT_CARET_LOCATION, org.eclipse.jdt.ui.PreferenceConstants.EDITOR_ENCLOSING_BRACKETS)
;;
summary: Adds new `HIGHLIGHT_BRACKET_AT_CARET_LOCATION` and `ENCLOSING_BRACKETS` preference keys as arguments to `SourceViewerDecorationSupport.setMatchingCharacterPainterPreferenceKeys`.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
